scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: At turn 1 and turn 7, the customer expressed acute emotional distress over losing a 25-year family landline vital for her elderly mother, but you moved straight to procedural database checks without acknowledging her feelings.

grader.scenario: Landline number of 25 years accidentally terminated during full-fibre switchover
grader.notes: Marcus performs exceptional technical recovery work, locating Elisha's 25-year landline number in quarantine and successfully reprovisioning it onto her Hub 5 Digital Voice adapter with two-way call verification. However, he fails Empathy by never acknowledging Elisha's distress regarding her vulnerable mother across multiple outbursts.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: [00:15] Customer: 'I am in absolute tears here. We had our full fibre broadband installed yesterday, and your engineer told us our landline number of twenty-five years had been permanently ceased...', Agent jumps straight to verification questions without acknowledgment.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Customer stated landline number at turn 13; Agent performed a valid harmless_recheck at turn 30 before conducting live call testing.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: [01:30] Agent stated: 'I will take direct ownership of this case and check the telephone number allocation database on the national numbering register.'

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: [14:20] Agent maintained a patient, supportive, and highly professional manner throughout an emotionally intense emergency recovery call.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: [14:20] Customer verified inbound ring and outbound caller ID matching 0115 941 8832.
